name: Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs
beschreibung: Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs is located on the outskirts of Innsbruck, near the western district of Völs. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as direct access to the Innradweg. In just a few minutes you can reach the city center of Innsbruck. The surroundings are characterized by meadows and a stream that borders the site. Guests can use a small shop, sanitary facilities and a barbecue area.
